set.prevailing_wage_basis: 24 CFR 983.153(c) (HUD PBV rule): for a PBV project developed under an Agreement (new construction or rehabilitation) with nine or more contract units, owners, contractors and subcontractors must pay Davis-Bacon wages and construction contracts must carry the Davis-Bacon clause and current wage determination. Applies only if HACM commits PBVs to a development of 9+ contract units; tenant-based vouchers and PBVs on existing housing do not trigger it. https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/24/983.153
set.audit_note: Tier 3: prevailing wage set true on the PBV development path per 24 CFR 983.153(c) (9+ contract units under an Agreement). HACM 2026 Agency Plan draft re-opened; still only exploring PBVs.

reason: HUD PBV rule 24 CFR 983.153(c) requires Davis-Bacon wages on PBV development projects with nine or more contract units; agency plan still shows PBVs only under evaluation.

set.prevailing_wage_basis: No program-specific rule found. HCD PLHA Final Guidelines (2019) and 2024-2028 PLHA Formula Guidelines contain no prevailing wage, Davis-Bacon or Labor Code 1720 provisions, and the City PLHA page does not mention labor standards. Coverage would rest only on the general Labor Code 1720(b) public-funds definition, with the outcome depending on 1720(c) exemptions and project facts.
